title: XPeX Global Launch Radar
positioning: AI Systems · Agents · Company Intelligence · Neural Workforce
launch_thesis: XPeX composes existing software, MCP tools, plugins, skills and governed agents into evidence-backed digital workers that expand human capability.
truth_boundary: This radar tracks public opportunity windows and XPeX readiness. A target is not a partnership, acceptance, investment or endorsement.

priority_targets.name: Y Combinator
priority_targets.rationale: Global top-tier accelerator; strong fit for AI infrastructure, agents and a technical founder with a working product portfolio.

priority_targets.name: Techstars
priority_targets.rationale: Explicit focus on AI/ML, enterprise SaaS and large markets; strong fit for enterprise agentic infrastructure.

priority_targets.name: Techstars
priority_targets.rationale: AI/ML and transformative technology focus with strong enterprise and technical network.

priority_targets.name: Techstars
priority_targets.rationale: Remote-first format lowers relocation friction while retaining Techstars investor and mentor network.

priority_targets.name: Techstars
priority_targets.rationale: Global founder intake across verticals and access to a major capital and enterprise ecosystem.

priority_targets.name: Antler
priority_targets.rationale: Rolling intake in the US and strong early-stage founder network.

priority_targets.name: Alchemist Accelerator
priority_targets.rationale: Enterprise and B2B focus maps directly to XPeX Company Intelligence, agentic systems and governed digital workers.

priority_targets.name: NVIDIA
priority_targets.rationale: Free AI startup program with technical resources, market visibility and investor-network exposure. Eligibility requires an incorporated company, working website and at least one developer.

priority_targets.name: Microsoft
priority_targets.rationale: Early-stage B2B software/AI program designed to help startups reach enterprise readiness and go to market.

priority_targets.name: AWS
priority_targets.rationale: Cloud credits, technical support and startup resources can reduce infrastructure cost and extend runway.

priority_targets.name: Google for Startups
priority_targets.rationale: Technical, product and leadership support for growth-stage startups; program windows vary by accelerator.

priority_targets.name: 500 Global
priority_targets.rationale: Strong global early-stage investor network, but the current official page presents inconsistent batch/deadline text; do not claim an open on-time window until reverified.
